jobs.name: impact
jobs.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL high-quality 2D fantasy game contact-impact FX spritesheet inspired by the reference, not a copy. Six animation frames in an EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows grid, same CENTER in every cell, wide transparent gutters and margin. Compact white-hot contact flash with soft cyan-white core, short ivory rays and a few blue/gold sparks, ring expands then breaks into dissipating motes. Frames: tiny spark, sharp contact star, expanding ring, fragmented ring, fading sparks, last small motes (not empty). Genuine transparent background, NO opaque backdrop or glow rectangle. No arrow, no sword, no character, no text. Clear readable at 64 pixels, refined detailed hand-painted game FX, no blocky enlarged pixels. Each complete frame entirely isolated with 15% clear padding; uniform registration and scale. This impact ends a projectile on hitting a body or wall and will also dissipate blue arrows on the ground.
